_doc: Canonical symbol map: semantic name -> Ravenswatch engine function/global. This is the source of truth (like Minecraft mappings). Ghidra names, the loader C++ header, and the Python SDK constants are all GENERATED from this file via `rsmm symbols gen`. Resolution: `raw` joins to data/function_patterns.json by name for version-resilient (byte-pattern) lookup; `anchor` is an inlined routine reached as parent_pattern + offset; `va` is a base-relative absolute (data globals, which have no code pattern). `status`: ok = pattern/anchor resolvable in the current corpus; va = base-relative only; unverified = documented in an older corpus, not yet re-confirmed against the shipped pattern DB.

symbols.name: MagicalObject_SpawnAllObjects
symbols.note: Spawns every magical-object resource into the runtime pool. Inlined inside FUN_1402586f0; runs once at boot during InitialLoading. Loader post-detours this to inject custom items.

symbols.name: MagicalObject_SpawnContainingFunc
symbols.note: Outer function (1283 bytes) that contains the inlined SpawnAllObjects entry at +0x70. This is the pattern-resolvable anchor.

symbols.name: InitialLoading_SpawnMagicalObjects
symbols.note: Boot 'InitialLoading - MagicalObject SpawnAllObjects' caller that invokes SpawnAllObjects(g_MagicalObjectPool, ...). Address from an older corpus; re-confirm against current pattern DB.

symbols.name: MagicalObjectPool_SourceLookup
symbols.signature: void*(void* pool, void* out, void* id)
symbols.note: Source-list lookup into the magical-object pool. Address from item-clone corpus; re-confirm.

symbols.name: Resource_LookupByPath
symbols.signature: void*(const char* decoded_path, void*, void*, void*)
symbols.note: Canonical resource-by-path hashmap lookup. RCX = decoded path; returns EntityResource* (0 if not loaded). Only resolves paths registered in UsedRscList/cache.

symbols.name: Definitions_LoadGroup
symbols.note: Loads the 'Definitions' group / VersionDefinition manifest (triggers loading the curated content list). Address from older corpus.

symbols.name: Vector_Grow
symbols.signature: void(void* vec, void* /*dead RDX*/, uint32_t new_cap /*R8*/)
symbols.note: Engine vector growth helper. new_cap is the 3rd arg (R8); RDX is dead. Used when force-pushing nodes into engine collections.

symbols.name: MagicalObjectPool_Grow
symbols.signature: void(void* pool_plus_0x10, uint32_t count, uint32_t by)
symbols.note: Grows the runtime array at pool+0x10 before storing a spawned component. Address from item-clone corpus.

symbols.name: Entity_AllocInstance
symbols.note: Allocates an entity instance from a resource (res+0x18). Address from item-clone corpus.

symbols.name: Entity_FindMagicalObjectComponent
symbols.note: Finds the magical-object component in a spawned entity instance (uses g_MagicalObjectComponentMeta). Address from item-clone corpus.

symbols.name: Entity_FindComponentByType
symbols.note: Generic find-sub-component-by-type on a spawner game object.

symbols.name: SkinRoster_Build
symbols.note: Skin-pack roster builder. Selectable-skin count (9) is baked into its loop; a new selectable skin needs a detour here, not pure data.

symbols.name: SkinGrid_Populate
symbols.note: Writes the visible skin roster into the grid; filter compares each node to 3. Loader post-detours this to force-push a custom node.

symbols.name: Reward_InitAllRewards
symbols.note: _InitAllRewards (7351 bytes): reward-type registrar. The actual reward roller is a sibling. oCDtRewardDefinition is the entity class.

symbols.name: Netcode_PeerStateTick
symbols.note: Per-peer connection-state tick (peer conn-state enum at peer+0xCC; 3=connected). Reconnect-window lever hooks here. Address from netcode corpus.

symbols.name: Netcode_DropPeer
symbols.note: Drops a peer after the reconnect window (default 60s) elapses. Address from netcode corpus.

symbols.name: Netcode_Channel_LookupById
symbols.note: Channel-lookup-by-id; paired with subscribe for named gameplay events (GIVE_MAGICAL_OBJECT). Address from events corpus.

symbols.name: Netcode_Channel_Subscribe
symbols.note: Subscribe to a gameplay-event channel. Address from events corpus.

symbols.name: String_Assign
symbols.note: Engine string-assign into a slot from a (ptr,len) StringDesc.

symbols.name: Entry_Ctor
symbols.note: Constructs an entry/array element used by the spawn path.

symbols.name: Format_String
symbols.note: printf-style format/string builder (e.g. 'Is Hero liked by {}', 'Chance to give {} MO'). Useful xref anchor for locating gameplay logic by its format literal.

symbols.name: g_MagicalObjectPool
symbols.note: Magical-object pool global pointer. Layout at *ptr: +0x0 source array, +0x8 source count, +0x10 runtime array, +0x18 runtime count.

symbols.name: g_RosterManager
symbols.note: Manager pointer global (relocated by the live image base) walked by the skin-grid populate path.

symbols.name: g_MagicalObjectComponentMeta
symbols.note: oCMetaClass* for the magical-object component; passed to Entity_FindMagicalObjectComponent.
